subtitle: Lesson 24 · Data Architecture Across Hybrid and Multi-Cloud

code:
lesson 21: compute is pulled toward where data lives
lesson 23: sovereignty can legally pin data to a region

so "one platform" cannot mean "one physical copy"

it means: one consistent FORMAT + one consistent CATALOG
           -- not one storage location
caption: A single platform is a governance abstraction, not a single physical bucket.

code:
object storage (ADLS / S3) + open table format
  -- Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi

any compute engine that understands the format can read it:
  Databricks Spark | Snowflake | Trino | Athena | Fabric

storage layer and compute engine are no longer the same product
caption: Decoupling storage from compute is what lets more than one cloud's engine read the same tables.
